summary: All 20 selected hypothalamic genes agreed in direction with the registered Ins2-versus-GFP result. Fourteen had fold changes estimated from Figure 4B, and six had directions reported only in the Discussion. The 14 numerical pairs fall below the 30-pair concordance minimum. The proposal passed validation, and all 38 downloaded source files passed checksum verification. [Published study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10529429/)
openIssues: The full author DESeq2 table and exact rule behind the 1,714 reported calls were not located. Genome-wide overlap and author FDR agreement remain unassessed.
The ten hypothalamic libraries are identifiable, but their mapping to individual mice or disjoint biological pools remains undocumented.
